issues.description: The problem text instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram and the solution/template use addGuestStudents(int). This parameter-type mismatch can confuse students about which signature to implement and will cause compilation/test mismatches if they follow the textual instruction instead of the UML/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement text to require addGuestStudents(int) (matching the UML and solution). Alternatively, if a String parameter is intended, update the UML, template, and solution to use addGuestStudents(String) and document how the String should be interpreted (e.g., parsed to int).
